about: Christina Lana Shine, Esq. works from Main Street in Williamsville and titles her site for divorce mediation. Her practice areas include a contested divorce as well as mediation, legal separation and an uncontested divorce, so she both mediates and litigates.

23 reviews at 4.1. She explains six stages of a matrimonial case and describes four routes through one, which is more than most firms here. Her site scores 23 out of 100, the lowest in this ranking, with a largest contentful paint of 19.3 seconds and 1.18 seconds of blocking time. She is one of five firms here to name a bar association, and she publishes no fee.
